title: Office app crashes opening one file
symptom: Word crashes only when opening a particular document
user_description: Word crashes every time I open one contract. All my other documents are fine. Please don't lose it!

options.why: Other documents open fine, so Office is working. The fault is more likely in the one file.

options.text: Delete the file and ask her to start again
options.why: Destroys her work when options for repair and recovery exist.

options.text: Check that other files open fine, try Open and Repair or open it on another PC, and restore an earlier version if the file is damaged
options.why: Testing other files proves the program is fine. Open and Repair, another PC and earlier versions give the best chance of recovering the document.
Drastic and does not help a single damaged file.

hints: If other files open, what does that tell you about where the fault is?
Does Office have a built-in way to repair a damaged file?
Might an earlier version of the file exist?
real_world_tip: Copy the file somewhere safe before trying anything. A repair attempt should never risk the only copy.
